intro: Legal clients search at stressful moments: an arrest, an injury, a divorce, a business dispute. They choose the firm that looks competent, trustworthy, and easy to contact. Law firm SEO is unlike any other kind, because Google holds legal content to its highest quality standard and bar rules limit what you can claim. I build lawyer websites that rank for their practice areas while staying firmly within ethical advertising rules: real expertise, clear credentials, and content that genuinely helps.

why.heading: How legal clients choose counsel
why.body: A legal search is high-stakes and research-heavy. Clients compare several firms, read attorney bios, look for case results they are allowed to publish, and weigh reviews carefully. Google's quality standards for legal content are strict: thin pages and generic claims do not rank, and misleading content can hurt you. The firms that win combine deep practice-area pages, genuine attorney authority, and a reputation footprint that reassures a nervous searcher. That is a slower build than most SEO, but the case values make it worth it.

section1.heading: Practice-area pages with real depth
section1.body: Each practice area gets a comprehensive page written around how clients actually search: 'divorce lawyer', 'personal injury attorney near me', the specific questions they ask first. These pages demonstrate expertise properly, with clear explanations, process outlines, and honest FAQ content. Attorney bio pages get the same treatment, because clients hire people, not firms. Everything is written to satisfy both Google's quality bar and your jurisdiction's advertising rules.

section2.heading: Authority and trust signals
section2.body: For lawyers, trust is the ranking factor you can feel. I build it systematically: consistent profiles across legal directories, genuine client reviews handled within ethical bounds, local citations done right, and content that earns links because it is actually useful. Your Google Business Profile gets the same careful treatment as any local business, with categories and services exact. No shortcuts, no review schemes, nothing that risks your license or your reputation.
